arguments.content: P1 review pattern: enabling an existing optional mode by default broadens the reach of inherited boundary failures. In batch-report review of HEAD a21036447ee7843887ddbaff82408db6e044b053 versus staged config.py, DETAILED_REPORT=True makes report([]) and report([], detailed=None) enter stats.summarize's unguarded mean calculation and raise ZeroDivisionError; base default calls returned Items: 0. The explicit detailed=True empty failure already existed, so distinguish that inherited bug from the new default-path regression. All four existing tests pass in both snapshots because they cover empty batches only with detailed=False. Check default/explicit mode combinations across valid empty and populated inputs when changing activation defaults; preserve count-only summaries for empty inputs and add focused empty default/detailed regression coverage.
